output.body: Isomorph: to count the items in a list, define len([]) = 0 as the base case, and len(list) = 1 + len(rest of list) as the recursive step, where rest drops the first item. For [a, b, c]: len = 1 + len([b, c]) = 1 + (1 + len([c])) = 1 + (1 + (1 + len([]))) = 3, because each call shrinks the list until the base case stops it.
